base_member_text: ha is grown dynamically (preallocation commented out at L48); callers in this directory pass gap=[.05 0.5] (large column gap) which with Nw=1 has no effect since gap(2) is only used when Nw>1 (L44, L59)

audit_member_text: Explicitly empty `gap` is not treated like an omitted argument: L29 only tests `nargin<3`, L33 skips expansion because numel([])=0, and L43-L44 then index gap(1:2), causing an indexing failure. `marg_h` has an explicit empty check at L30, showing the interface handling is inconsistent.

Explicitly empty `marg_w` likewise bypasses the L31 default and L36 expansion, then L44/L51 index an empty array; the fifth-argument interface therefore fails for `[]` although the fourth argument accepts it.

No validation constrains Nh/Nw to positive integers or two-element vector arguments to exactly two entries (L33-L44); zero dimensions can divide by zero and longer vectors affect sum(marg_*) while only the first two elements are used for placement.
